scenes.narration: One evening, Lumi the firefly saw a little bunny crying in the forest.
I am lost, said Ben. I cannot find my way home.
Lumi smiled. Follow my tiny light. We can find the path together.
They crossed a stream and walked past the tall trees.
At last, Ben saw his cozy home. Thank you, Lumi!
Even a small light can make a big difference. The end.
